text:
maria: quick sync: CloudCo marketplace enablement. goal: ship a repeatable refkit (terraform modules + one-click template + tiny demo) by EOW. who picks what?
aj: I can take terraform modules + CI. will include tflint, tfsec, and a basic terratest. keeping modules small: network, compute, observability.
devon: i'll do the instance/ami matrix. CloudCo specifically asked for arm64 recommendations and an accelerated gpu flavor. will list kernel flags and driver notes.
samir: i'll build the demo app that hits the Redwood API and emits Prometheus metrics. want a smoke load script to reproduce latency/cost.
elaine: i'll own marketplace packaging, quickstart doc + short video, and partner submission checklist. also draft the partner-facing announcement copy.
aj: proposed module inputs: region, vpc_id, subnet_ids, image_id, instance_type, gpu_profile, instance_count, quant_profile (optional). Examples must be copy-paste friendly.
maria: yes, modules should be composable and pluggable. keep defaults conservative.
devon: i'll start a repo doc for AMIs: https://github.com/redwood/refkit/blob/main/AMIS.md (WIP). will call out x86_64 vs arm64 and recommended images for CUDA/ROCm.
aj: snippet for README: ```hcl
module "refkit_compute" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/refkit.git//modules/compute"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = "g5.2xlarge"
  image_id = var.image_id
  instance_count = 2
}
```
keep it minimal.
marketplace-bot: checklist: listing requires docs, quickstart, terraform registry entry, automated smoke test, support_contact.
elaine: CloudCo needs a one-click template + a 2-min explainer clip. i'll coordinate design for a slide and record a demo.
samir: telemetry: i'll wire Prom + Grafana out of the box and add a dashboard showing p50/p95 latency and token cost per request.
maria: action items: aj=modules+CI, devon=AMI matrix+compat notes, elaine=packaging+docs+announce draft, samir=demo+dashboard. i'll open tracking issue and assign.
aj: i'll aim for a scaffold PR by Tue EOD. CI will run validate, tflint, tfsec, terratest smoke.
devon: will post AMI matrix tomorrow and tag aj for defaults. include notes for driver installs (CUDA/ROCm), nvidia driver versions, and kernel args.
elaine: will paste the marketplace page template here for quick feedback before submission.
samir: request: include a small transformer inference script and a reproducible cost runbook (seed, batch size, seq len). sales will love it.
maria: agreed. keep numbers reproducible and script-driven.
aj: version modules semver (v0.1.0), publish to terraform registry. release notes: supported clouds, known limitations, supported instance types.
marketplace-bot: reminder: attach partner_agreement to listing.
maria: scheduling a short sync with CloudCo PM tomorrow 11am PT to align on timeline. who can join?
aj: I'll join.
devon: in.
samir: I can pop in for first 10m.
elaine: attending and will take notes.
maria: thanks everyone. i'll open the tracking issue and ping updates here. :rocket:
